blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Service for Your Business
blocks.intro: Commercial water heaters work harder and longer than residential ones. We service them for businesses like:

tiles.body: Dishwashing, handwashing and prep all depend on hot water at the right temperature. When it drops, service stops.
Back-to-back appointments need steady hot water all day, not a tank that runs out by noon.
Restrooms and break rooms still need reliable hot water, without a heater that's bigger or smaller than you need.
Showers and laundry put heavy demand on a heater. Sizing and maintenance keep it from failing at peak hours.

blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Repair, Replacement and Maintenance
blocks.intro: One company for the whole life of your heater:

steps.body: We diagnose tank and tankless commercial heaters, gas and electric, and fix what's failing so you can get back to business.
We size the new heater for your peak demand, install it to code and schedule the swap to limit downtime.
Regular flushing, descaling and safety checks extend the life of a heater that works harder than any residential unit.

img.alt: Dishwasher rinsing a pan under a pre-rinse sprayer at a stainless steel sink in a busy restaurant kitchen

blocks.h2: Serving Highland Park and North Shore Businesses
blocks.intro: Our plumbers serve businesses in Highland Park and nearby North Shore communities.

items.body: A failed heater can close a kitchen or cancel appointments. Our phone line is open 24/7, including weekends and holidays, and we work to get a plumber to you as soon as we can.
In a Lake County winter, incoming water is colder and the heater works harder. That's when an undersized or aging commercial heater is most likely to fail.
You get a flat-rate price before any work begins, so you can make the call for your business with the numbers in front of you.

blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Questions From Highland Park Businesses

items.q: Can you work around our business hours?
items.preview: We try to schedule planned work around your hours. For a failure, call any time.
items.answer: We'll do our best to schedule planned work, like a replacement or maintenance, around your hours to limit downtime. For a failure, call us any time. Our line is open 24/7.

items.q: What size commercial water heater does my business need?
items.preview: It depends on your peak demand. We size it for your busiest hour.
items.answer: It depends on your peak hot water demand: how many fixtures, dishwashers or showers run at the same time, and the temperature you need. We size the heater for your busiest hour.

items.q: How often should a commercial water heater be serviced?
items.preview: More often than a home heater. We set a schedule based on your use.
items.answer: Commercial heaters work harder than residential ones, so they benefit from more frequent flushing, descaling and safety checks. We'll recommend a schedule based on your heater and your use.

items.q: How much does commercial water heater replacement cost?
items.preview: It depends on capacity, fuel and code updates. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the heater's capacity, fuel type, venting and any code updates required. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
